title: Platform - Delivery & Edge
description: Flux delivery state and native Envoy and cloudflared edge telemetry. Tunnel metrics are shared by every application; no log line is counted as a failure.

panels.title: Flux resource readiness and delivered revisions
panels.description: Readiness and applied revision of every Flux object, from kube-state-metrics custom-resource metrics. A not-ready row means Git is not delivered for that object; read why in the Flux controller logs below.

panels.title: Flux reconciliation attempts / 15 minutes
panels.description: Reconciliations per Flux object kind over the previous 15 minutes. A kind that stops reconciling is stuck; a burst usually follows a Git push or a retry loop.

panels.title: Flux reconciliation mean duration (only observed attempts)
panels.description: Average time one reconciliation took per kind, in seconds (not uptime); empty when nothing reconciled. A sustained rise points at slow sources or Helm upgrades.

panels.title: Native edge scrape health: 1 reachable, 0 failed
panels.description: Envoy and cloudflared metrics targets: 1 reachable, 0 failed. A missing row is unknown; EdgeScrapeFailed alerts on failed or absent targets.

panels.title: Cloudflared active edge connections per replica
panels.description: Tunnel connections each cloudflared replica holds to Cloudflare's edge (normally 4). Fewer means less redundancy; 0 means that replica carries no traffic.

panels.title: Envoy upstream requests by route cluster / 15 minutes
panels.description: Requests Envoy sent upstream per route cluster over 15 minutes: real proxy activity. A route dropping to zero while others continue points at that route or its backend.

panels.title: Envoy upstream connect failures and timeouts / 15 minutes
panels.description: Failed upstream connections and request timeouts per route cluster over 15 minutes. Any value means Envoy could not reach or wait for a backend; EdgeUpstreamFailure alerts on application routes.

panels.title: Cloudflared HTTP responses by status / 15 minutes (shared)
panels.description: HTTP responses cloudflared returned by status over 15 minutes. Shared by every application behind the tunnel, so it cannot be split per application.

panels.title: Cloudflared origin proxy errors / 15 minutes (shared)
panels.description: Requests cloudflared could not proxy to the origin over 15 minutes, per pod. Shared by every application; check Envoy health and the cloudflared logs below.

panels.title: Flux controller logs only
panels.description: Raw Flux controller logs. Use them to read why a reconciliation failed; lines are not counted as failures.

panels.title: Cloudflared logs only
panels.description: Raw cloudflared logs: tunnel connection changes and origin errors. Shared by every application; not a failure count.

panels.title: Envoy safe access/runtime logs only (shared edge)
panels.description: Access records use route names, not original request paths/queries. Runtime records remain raw/UNKNOWN; these are not request-failure counts.
